technique_name: Identify and explain the four major ocean currents.
description: The four major ocean currents are the North Atlantic Drift, Gulf Stream, Kuroshio Current, and Rhumb Line. The North Atlantic Drift is a significant western boundary current in the Atlantic Ocean and is part of the North Atlantic Gyre. The Gulf Stream is a warm, swift Atlantic Ocean current that originates in the Gulf of Mexico and flows northeastward toward Europe.
